title: Appearance Versioning and Migration Engine Contract

recoverability_classes.meaning: All referenced semantic IDs and required capabilities remain valid without transformation.
Every changed identifier has an explicit authoritative one-to-one migration mapping.
At least one removed, ambiguous, missing-pack, unsupported-renderer, or unknown target reference requires user/operator review.
Required source identity cannot be represented or safely reconstructed under the target contract.
Authority is insufficient to determine migration behavior.

migration_map_contract.rule: Mappings are explicit data; similarity, display-name matching, filename matching, or AI guessing may not silently create a migration.

event_behavior.behavior: apply explicit stable-ID mapping; otherwise review_required
preserve unresolved source value in migration receipt; never choose replacement automatically
apply only versioned deterministic field transforms; preserve unknown fields in diagnostic receipt when safe
re-evaluate CAPP-04 coverage; renderer gaps do not invalidate Character state
recompile CAPP-05 render plan; downgrade support state explicitly if required
Character/preset remains semantically valid; renderer state becomes missing/unknown and derivative becomes stale
validate stable IDs, profile eligibility and locks before application to draft; unresolved items require review
produce review receipt separating exact, mapped, unresolved and blocked fields
re-evaluate visual fit only; inventory/equipment truth unchanged
invalidate permission-sensitive derivatives and regenerate from newly filtered state

silent_substitution_forbidden: removed choice to nearest display name
missing asset to visually similar asset
invalid equipment fit to warped asset
unknown biological field to absent/zero/human default
hidden field to unfiltered export value
preset_lock_rules: Mapped lock IDs follow the same explicit mapping as their choice IDs.
Removed/unknown lock IDs require review and are not reassigned silently.
Locks protect authored appearance choices only; they do not freeze source-owned biology, mechanics, or equipment state.
